title: Peter Norvig - The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Data
summary: Peter Norvig's UBC distinguished lecture on how massive amounts of simple data, such as for language modeling, can yield understanding that hand-built models could not.
why: Recommended as a favorite tech talk showing how huge data availability changes how problems are approached.

quote.text: Norvig does an especially great job in making you truly appreciate the seismic impact that the availability of massive quantities of data can have
